basic_profile.bio: Avid gamer and tech enthusiast hailing from Seattle, Washington. I spend my weekdays working as a software developer for a mid-sized tech company, and my weekends are devoted to exploring new video games and tinkering with robotics. I'm currently single and enjoy attending comic cons and tech expos. Most active on Reddit during the evenings and late nights, especially after 8 PM PST. I'm a fan of old-school video games and have a soft spot for retro consoles.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a bachelor's degree in Computer Science from the University of Washington, I have a solid foundation in software development and IT. Over the years, I've expanded my expertise through self-teaching and online courses in game development and robotics. My curiosity often leads me to participate in tech forums and hackathons.
